model: label-noise scenario envelope: flip rate drawn as Normal(mean=observed coder-vs-label bucket error rate, sd=0.02), clipped at 0; 4000 draws per scenario; seed 7. Scenario "symmetric" flips strong/non-strong labels at random in either direction (null-attenuating); scenario "strong_to_weak" flips strong labels to weak only (the direction of the observed coder disagreements).
